label: The Road
prompt:
Create a piece of conceptual storyboard art on aged textured paper for a sequence titled "The Road / Jacob's Well."

The page should look like rough but beautiful animation development art, drawn in expressive black ink with muted watercolor washes. Use a hand-drawn storyboard aesthetic with visible sketch lines, brush textures, rough edges, handwritten notes, and a vintage paper base.

The page layout should include:

a title at the top left: "SEQ: The Road / Jacob's Well"
frame number text "F06" at the top right
a top row of three storyboard panels
a large full-scene illustration filling the lower half of the page
small annotation sketches and handwritten notes integrated naturally

Top storyboard panels:

A close-up portrait of Jesus — a lean bearded first-century man with dark shoulder-length hair and a subtle abstract halo — his face weary from travel, eyes half-lowered. Label the panel "1". Under it, handwrite: "F06: WEARIED WITH HIS JOURNEY".
A sketch of a long dusty road winding through dry hills toward a distant town, labeled "2".
A sketch of Jesus lowering himself to sit on the stone rim of a well, labeled "3". To the side, include the handwritten note: "NOTE: Noon Heat".

In the large lower illustration, show Jesus sitting alone on the low stone wall of Jacob's well, shoulders tired, hands resting on his knees. The landscape around him is sparse and open — rolling dry ground, scattered olive trees, the town of Sychar small on the horizon. The scene is still and quiet, almost empty.

At the bottom left, include a small distant drawing of the disciples walking away down the road toward the town, with the handwritten note: "DISCIPLES GO TO BUY MEAT".

Color palette: black ink, ochre, muted green, brown, and touches of soft gold wash — keep blue almost entirely absent from this page, no more than a faint trace.

The art style should remain rough, expressive, and exploratory — more like animation concept art than finished illustration.

Avoid photorealism, polished graphic design, clean comic-book inking, and overly neat layout. The page should feel handmade, thoughtful, and alive.
